record.question: The following statement is not correct
options: Cracks in RCC water tank caused due to expansion and contraction due to shrinkage can be avoided by proper use of movement joints
Cracks in RCC water tank caused by differential expansion due to heat of hydration are not likely to occur in member less than 450 mm thick
Crack in RCC water tank caused by settlement can be minimized or avoided by careful site selection and good foundation design
The safety factor against cracking is more than the safety factor required for structural safety
